[[Isaiah's Balance (Unique)| Isaiah's Balance]] is a  [[unique item|unique]] [[recurve bow]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28  (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while health is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Forked Hornbow]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==

*One of the following [[recurve bow]]s:
**[[Ascalon Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[John Verado]] or [[Bariel Darkroot]]
**[[Recurve Bow (weapon)|Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Dye Master Franjek]]
**[[Sturdy Recurve Bow]] from collectors [[Dayoesh]], [[Pathfinder Mia]], or [[Cait]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Destroyer Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Recurve Bow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Bow of the Hierophant]], [[Stygian Recurve Bow]], and [[Droknar's Recurve Bow]] have stats identical to this item.
*The following bows have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes:
**[[Drago's Flatbow]], [[Urgoz's Flatbow]], [[Droknar's Flatbow]], [[Nooseknitter's Flatbow]]
**[[Koren's Hornbow]], [[Droknar's Hornbow]]
**[[Forgotten Longbow]], [[Urgoz's Longbow]], [[Arachni's Longbow]], [[Droknar's Longbow]], [[Deldrimor Longbow (unique)]]
**[[Uhiwi's Shortbow]], [[Urgoz's Shortbow]], [[Ashlyn's Shortbow]], [[Droknar's Shortbow]]

==Trivia==
* The bow was named after [[Isaiah Cartwright]], the primary developer responsible for skill balancing the game's skills. 
* This bow is a replica of the one wielded by [[Confessor Isaiah]].
